title: Two Countries One Heart — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk mbira acoustic guitar Spanish Italian language learning warm baritone 106bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe-Australia journey celebration Shona
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
She brought the red dust with her.
In the way she says hello to strangers.
They built a third country — the one not on any map.
Two countries. One heart.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Ella trajo el polvo rojo consigo. (She brought the red dust with her.)
En la forma en que saluda a los extraños. (In the way she says hello to strangers.)
Construyeron un tercer país — el que no está en ningún mapa. (They built a third country — the one not on any map.)
Mufaro ndewose — la felicidad pertenece a todos. (Happiness belongs to everyone.)
Dos países, un corazón (Two countries, one heart)
Zimbabue por la mañana (Zimbabwe in the morning)
Australia por la tarde (Australia in the evening)
Dos países, un corazón (Two countries, one heart)

[Chorus - Italian, with English translations]
Due paesi, un cuore (Two countries, one heart)
Lo Zimbabwe al mattino (Zimbabwe in the morning)
L'Australia alla sera (Australia in the evening)
Due paesi, un cuore (Two countries, one heart)
Il mbira e il merlo australiano (The mbira and the magpie)
Cantano insieme (Singing together)
Due paesi, un cuore (Two countries, one heart)
L'unica mappa di cui hanno bisogno (The only map they need)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The family left the farm. But they brought it with them. Australia got lucky.
Spanish: La familia dejó la granja. Pero la llevaron consigo. Australia tuvo suerte. (The family left the farm. But brought it. Australia got lucky.)
Italian: La famiglia ha lasciato la fattoria. Ma l'hanno portata con sé. L'Australia ha avuto fortuna. (The family left the farm. But brought it. Australia got lucky.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Two countries — one heart — yes
Spanish: Dos países — un corazón — sí (Two countries — one heart — yes)
Italian: Due paesi — un cuore — sì (Two countries — one heart — yes)
